john-cruikshank.text: Says that during two council terms (2017-2024) he "never raised taxes, championed limited government"; pledges to oppose unfunded mandates and "policies that lead to increased fees, taxes." "Government should live within its means."

john-cruikshank.text: Calls the Portuguese Bend landslide the city's biggest infrastructure challenge and pledges aggressive advocacy for county, state and federal remediation funding.

john-cruikshank.text: Fire safety priority: home hardening, vegetation management, evacuation planning and grant funding to mitigate wildfire risk.
